correctness.rationale: The free 1/2 molecular cost is exactly min over 16 spanning-tree square-root flow costs: cycles can be eliminated by concavity and flows on a tree are fixed by cut masses. Bilinearity yields exact midpoint secants and sign symmetries reduce to a,b>=0, a+r b=1; four sign regions exhaust q=ay+bx. In three regions two path costs plus Cauchy and majorization bound by 1+1/sqrt2<=F_r. In the horizontal mixed region a nonnegative concave combination gamma F1+eta F2+gamma F3 has zero gradient at the exhibited point and proves the global bound. At m=(-r-1,r,-r,r+1)/(3r+1) the eight 16-tree cost patterns give the exact lower bound F_r; symmetric interior secants attain F_r^2. Derivative F_r'=(1/sqrt r-1/sqrt(r+1))/(3r+1)^(3/2)>0. Independent separately coded enumeration of 16 trees confirmed the exact target at r=1,2,3,5,11; this is only finite corroboration.
